chat_ownership_changed.why: Tool admission found the chat's owner is not the acting user (403). No tool ran; the assistant tells the user this chat is not theirs and does not retry. Distinct from restriction_unavailable, which means the saved-rule store could not be read.

project_binding_changed.why: Tool admission found the active project is no longer the one the chat resolved (409). No tool ran; the assistant tells the user to reopen the project and does not retry. Distinct from restriction_unavailable, which means the saved-rule store could not be read.
